_doc: Per-map frame budgets for the GPU QC (tools/qc-gpu.js; npm run qc:map -- <map> --gpu, tools/qc.mjs): one frame at a QC site, Balanced quality, 1280x720. Over budget = a failing check. Set from the 25 Nov measurements with headroom; '*' is the default for any map not listed. 'target' (fidelity plan v5, 26 Nov 2026): the tier budgets the maps are moving to — over a target is a warning (overTarget), over a map's own cap still fails.

_tiers._doc: Fidelity plan v5 budgets per tier (provisional until the step 2 sweep). gpuMs: sustained GPU ms a frame; renderMP: render megapixels; gpuMB: GPU memory; programs: shader programs (pipelines).
